comparison.objective: Unlatch one terminal block from a loose DIN rail and place it in a tray without disturbing neighboring blocks; candidate adjusts an installed damper and verifies its setting.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests counterholding, push-tip-slide snap-fit release, extraction, transport, and gentle placement. Candidate tests captive setscrew unlocking, hex-bit re-engagement, collar micro-rotation, bounded tightening, control actuation, and iterative response correction.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires the target released and still on the tray floor while neighbors stay latched within 1 mm and rail motion remains limited. Candidate requires two safe repeatable impact stops and post-lock setting retention.
comparison.reason: Selective snap-fit disassembly and placement are meaningfully different from adjustment, locking, and dynamic commissioning; shared counterholding and contact-rich manipulation are generic primitives.
